source: Ex novo Tennis Europe engine: global TournamentSoftware calendar discovery + official acceptance lists. For scheduled tournaments reads /sport/acceptancelist.aspx and classifies players as MD-n, Q-n, A-n; Withdrawn is excluded from calendar. Dates are overridden from official tournament/events/acceptance pages. No FITP/P.U.C., no v1/v2/data.json.

startedTournamentRule.rule: Same rule for boys and girls: before tournament start use acceptance labels MD/Q/A; from tournament start keep only players found in official draw data and remove MD/Q/A labels; remove players only present in acceptance list but absent from draws.
